🎥🎬: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021)

After Peter Parker’s identity as Spider-Man is revealed to the world, his life is turned upside down as he struggles with the consequences of fame and danger. Seeking help, Peter turns to Doctor Strange and asks for a spell that will make everyone forget his secret, but the spell goes wrong and opens the door to villains from other universes.

As enemies from different Spider-Man realities arrive, Peter faces powerful threats while learning that saving others comes with painful sacrifices. The arrival of other Spider-Men helps him understand what it truly means to be a hero.

source_details.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
source_details.synopsis: Spider-Man: No Way Home is a 2021 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man. Produced by Columbia Pictures, Marvel Studios, and Pascal Pictures, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, it is the sequel to Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017) and Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), and the 27th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). The film was directed by Jon Watts, written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, and stars Tom Holland as Peter Parker / Spider-Man alongside Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon, Jon Favreau, Jamie Foxx, Willem Dafoe, Alfred Molina, Benedict Wong, Tony Revolori, Marisa Tomei, Andrew Garfield, and Tobey Maguire.
